dict.string: The camera scans lobby QR codes, recognizes station signs so you can complete tasks, and takes the selfie you can put on your crewmate.
Bluetooth detects which players are physically near you, which is how kills and body reports work.
Your location places station pins on the mini-map and can verify you reached a station. It's only shared with other players when the host turns on live positions for testing.
Counting your steps and reading the barometer keeps your dot on the map accurate indoors, where GPS is unreliable.
Connects to the game server running on your local Wi-Fi network.
